about: TCS <-> DCS links of lane 2 TCS IO. Not a src/world/bind file: those rows are FROM references of the DITL / ABC drawings (README there); these join a DCS I/O list point or a Modbus word to a TCS end, for the TCS program when it runs in the app. DCS I/O list points that join the TCS (hardwired DCS <-> TCS) or the generator panels, lane 2 TCS IO. stn / addr / tag / d / t = the DCS I/O list row (src/data/ades.txt); dir in = the DCS reads it, out = the DCS drives it; to = the TCS end: a PI/O table row of src/data/tcs-io.json (TCE9xx / TCA9xx-n, its value in src/digital/tce-io.js), an IBD net (IBD:<sheet>#<net> of tcs-ibd-data.js), the TCS Modbus unit (MOD:) or a non-TCS panel (GCP: generator control panel, GPP: generator protection panel) with the drawing to read; src = the rows and sheets that prove it.

aboutModbus: TCS <-> DCS Modbus (LMYP-1 #1-MODBUS Communication list between DCS and turbine system.xls: sheet PLC to DCS 227 rows, DCS to PLC 25 rows, under 3 heading rows each). sh / row = the sheet and row of the list; ma = Modbus address; word = the STN102 word the list writes on the first row of a block (PLC to DCS: Area-1 address for STN102; DCS to PLC: STN102 address), bit = the point in a DI / DO word (ma - the first ma of the block); to = the TCS end: a PI/O table row of src/data/tcs-io.json, MB:<ma> / MB:DO<ma> of src/digital/tce-io.js, or SPARE (a row with no tag and no description).
